body: Correction to the DM-429 submission notes: they paraphrased the sprint exit criteria wrongly. Mapped to the saved plan wording, the evidence is: x1 (comment, card and ticket mockups from the dm CLI survive deleting state.sqlite in repo mode): c4, c5, c7, c13 and docs/verification/image-attachments/sprint-2/x1-*.png. x2 (paste, drop or pick in the composer, card form and ticket editor): c8, c9. x3 (packets list references; get_attachment returns a readable copy): c5 packetOf excerpt, c6, docs/verification/image-attachments/sprint-2/x3-get-attachment-file.txt. x4 (storage status shows images and failed exports; guides and runbook): c10, c14, docs/runbooks/cli.md, DM-435 guides. x5 (every Definition of Done check passes locally and in CI; every success criterion evidenced): c1, PR #18 run 42236760497 all green (the test job passed on rerun after two real-git timeouts in the coverage step), docs/verification/image-attachments/sprint-2/epic-outcome.md.
